description: This file defines a DashboardPage class for automating interactions with dashboards in the Superset frontend using Playwright. It includes methods for navigation, waiting for load states, and interacting with dashboard menus.

classes.name: DashboardPage
classes.description: A page object model class for interacting with dashboards in the Superset frontend.

methods.name: gotoBySlug
methods.description: Navigates to a dashboard URL using its slug.

methods.name: gotoById
methods.description: Navigates to a dashboard URL using its ID.

methods.name: waitForLoad
methods.description: Waits for the dashboard header to be visible, indicating the page has loaded.

methods.name: waitForChartsToLoad
methods.description: Waits until all chart loading indicators are hidden, indicating charts have finished loading.

methods.name: openHeaderActionsMenu
methods.description: Opens the dashboard header actions menu.

methods.name: selectDownloadOption
methods.description: Selects a download option from the dashboard's header menu and returns the download event.
